system.title: System Information
system.subtitle: Real-time monitoring and diagnostics • Last updated: {{date}} • Refreshing data every 30 seconds

highMemory.title: Very High Memory Usage Detected
highMemory.message: System memory usage exceeds 90%. Performance degradation may occur.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Advanced configuration for operators. These settings are optional — the defaults work for most deployments.
advanced.connectivityIntro: NOMAD periodically checks whether it can reach the internet. By default it probes Cloudflare's utility endpoint with a few fallbacks. Set a custom endpoint below if your network blocks the defaults. Leave blank to use the built-in defaults.

envOverride.title: Managed by environment variable
envOverride.message: The INTERNET_STATUS_TEST_URL environment variable is set and takes precedence over this setting. Remove it to manage the test URL here.

testUrl.label: Internet Status Test URL
testUrl.help: A single http(s) URL used to check connectivity. Any HTTP response counts as online.

errors.protocol: Test URL must use http or https.
errors.invalid: Test URL must be a valid URL (e.g. "https://example.com").

advanced.updateError: There was an error updating the setting. Please try again.

support.title: Support the Project
support.intro: Project NOMAD is 100% free and open source — no subscriptions, no paywalls, no catch. If you'd like to help keep the project going, here are a few ways to show your support.

coffee.title: Buy Us a Coffee
coffee.description: Every contribution helps fund development, server costs, and new content packs for NOMAD. Even a small donation goes a long way.

network.title: Need Help With Your Home Network?
network.alt: Rogue Support — Conquer Your Home Network
network.description: Rogue Support is a networking consultation service for home users. Think of it as Uber for computer networking — expert help when you need it.

other.title: Other Ways to Help
other.starSuffix: it helps more people discover NOMAD
other.share: Share NOMAD with someone who'd use it — word of mouth is the best marketing
other.discordSuffix: hang out, share your build, help other users

creatorPacks.intro: Install branded video collections from creators. Packs download in the background and play offline through Kiwix.

update.title: System Update
update.intro: Keep your Project NOMAD instance up to date with the latest features and improvements.

restarting.title: Container Restarting
restarting.message: The admin container is restarting. This page will reload automatically when the update is complete.

connectionLost.title: Connection Temporarily Lost (Expected)
connectionLost.message: You may see error notifications while the backend restarts during the update. This is completely normal and expected. Connection should be restored momentarily.

update.availableDescription: A new version ({{version}}) is available for your Project NOMAD instance.
update.upToDateDescription: Your system is running the latest version!

pull.title: Pull Latest Images
pull.description: Downloads the newest Docker images for all core containers

recreate.title: Recreate Containers
recreate.description: Safely stops and recreates all core containers with the new images

reload.title: Automatic Reload
reload.description: This page will automatically reload when the update is complete

backup.title: Backup Reminder
backup.message: While updates are designed to be safe, it's always recommended to backup any critical data before proceeding.

downtime.title: Temporary Downtime
downtime.message: Services will be briefly unavailable during the update process. This typically takes 2-5 minutes depending on your internet connection.

earlyAccess.title: Early Access
earlyAccess.label: Enable Early Access
earlyAccess.description: Receive release candidate (RC) versions before they are officially released. Note: RC versions may contain bugs and are not recommended for environments where stability and data integrity are critical.

newsletter.title: Want to stay updated with the latest from Project NOMAD? Subscribe to receive release notes directly to your inbox. Unsubscribe anytime.
newsletter.privacy: We care about your privacy. Project NOMAD will never share your email with third parties or send you spam.

apps.title: Apps
apps.subtitle: Manage the applications that are available in your Project NOMAD instance. Nightly update checks will automatically detect when new versions of these apps are available.
